source.name: Draken RPG Maps: Night City 2020
source.note: Independent pixel trace from fan overview; positions/geometries are approximate and do not establish exact canonical parcel boundaries.

policy: All96 numbers and approximate label-box centres were read visually from the supplied Draken overview. Numbers identify this illustration only; match canonical catalog records by English name+source/district, never by integer. These are fan-reference positions; primary Sourcebook district plans supersede disagreements. No extracted source-plan numeric ID is invented here.

locations.note: Draken calls this NC Technical School. The Sourcebook catalog uses Night City Technical College (B3#12). Confirm identity before conflating it with Technical Exchange (A2#18).

Draken places this near the south coast. Sourcebook The Slammer is A4#3 / Upper Eastside, and Core Rulebook position48 is also north/east of central plaza. This Draken coordinate must not override primary district evidence.
Legend has a nightclub Cafe Chrome at13 and a bar Café Chrome at86. Treat as distinct source entries until Sourcebook identity is resolved, not duplicate pins of one place.
Spelling in Draken differs: Bodakkan Performing Arts Center versus canonical catalog Bodukkan Performance Center.

matchEnglish: The Kuroshita Hotel and Convention Center

locations.note: Draken legend spells The Havenfort; Sourcebook A4#22 is The Havenford Hotel.

Draken places Short Circuit in the West Hill vicinity. The existing primary catalog locates the named venue in B4 / Medical Center. Correct by primary district evidence before publishing canonical coordinate.
Draken legend says Kosher Deli; the Core Rulebook canonical name is Jesse James’ Non-Kosher Deli. Do not lose Non-.
Draken puts24HourCafe near the eastern road junction; Sourcebook A5#10 places24HourCafe in Upper Marina. Exact location needs reconciliation with primary district plan.
Draken legend typo Nice City Metro Airport was normalized to Night City Metro Airport; this small city metro airport is not the modern international airport.
